title: Xdrip+ mi band 4 Legal Time issue
symptom: After the end of Legal Time (Oct 25) and return to Civil Time (1 hour back), Mi Band 4 time is unchanged, so it is 1 hour forward.
cause: The time is not synchronized between xDrip and the Mi Band; the watch time is from the initial setup with MiFit.
fix: Connect with the MiFit app to sync the new time. The user confirmed that using the original Mi Fit app solved the issue, but required repeating the xDrip connection procedure.
evidence_quote: The time is not syncronised between xDrip and the Miband. The time on your watch is from the initial setup with MiFit. The solution is to connect with the MiFit app to sync the new time.
